caption: The drawing depicts a single, large pitcher with a rounded body, an elegantly curved handle, and a wide spout. The body of the pitcher is primarily dark green, with lighter green highlights and reflections, giving it a glossy and reflective appearance. The handle is also dark green, matching the body, and it curves smoothly from the upper rim to the side of the pitcher. The base is circular, clear, and rendered in shades of grey and white, mimicking the look of transparent glass or crystal. There are white highlights throughout the jug indicating reflective surfaces and depth. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Pitcher
